$comment: Canonical cross-site data for Jamie's sites. Edit here only; consumers vendor a copy (www.thingelstad.com/scripts/sync-shared.sh -> thing-hugo/data/sites.json; npm run sites:sync in thingy.thingelstad.com/web, weekly.thingelstad.com, another.thingelstad.com, thingelstad.xyz and links.thingelstad.xyz). in_sites_strip picks the sites the sites strip and the blog's footer list, and strip_label is the one label a site has in that strip on every site, its own included; in_publishing_system says only whether WT Builder and librarian-thing work with the site. Call these sites or properties, never a network.
